summary: Applied 3 spec review repairs for freshness fingerprints, risk skip allowlist, and completion contract handling.

items.title: Freshness proof does not cover same-path changes
items.rationale: R1 now requires command identity including argv/env/source/metadata or script/config digest and changed-file fingerprints instead of path/source membership only.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[0].desc and acceptance_criteria[0..1] now cover immutable freshness evidence.

items.title: Risk skip relies on an unsafe non-runtime boundary
items.rationale: R2 now defines explicit allowlisted path classes and requires all non-allowlisted, unknown, runtime, config, runner, dependency, and integration paths to run full regression.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1].desc and acceptance_criteria[2] now define the allowlist and fail-closed fallback.

items.title: Completion contract path is omitted for skipped results
items.rationale: R4 and T-2 now require flow-judgment-contract completion policy support in addition to validator, schema, and registry post-hook support.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc and tasks[1].acceptance[2] now name flow judgment contract skipped completion.
